supplements.title: Open-Label Randomized Phase II Trial of Megestrol Acetate With or Without Pterostilbene in Patients With Endometrial Cancer Scheduled for Hysterectomy
supplements.summary: Researchers tested megestrol acetate with or without pterostilbene to treat endometrial cancer before surgery.

supplements.title: Applying Lifestyle Medicine to Enhance Cancer Survivorship and Patient Well-being.
supplements.summary: Lifestyle medicine—including exercise, nutrition, sleep, stress management, and social connection—improves cancer survivorship and patient outcomes.

supplements.title: ZIF-8/polydopamine nanocomposite functionalized with hyaluronic acid and folic acid for pH-responsive resveratrol delivery and apoptosis induction in colorectal cancer.
supplements.summary: A nanoparticle delivery system successfully released resveratrol into colorectal cancer cells, triggering apoptosis and reducing cancer cell growth in laboratory tests.

supplements.title: Targeting Pyruvate Kinase M2: Signal Transduction Pathways and Exploration of Cancer Therapeutic Strategies.
supplements.summary: Blocking pyruvate kinase M2 shows promise as a cancer treatment by disrupting key tumor-promoting pathways, though clinical application remains challenging.

supplements.title: Cross-kingdom signals: microbial, metabolites, and immune cells on the gut-breast axis.
supplements.summary: Gut microbes and their metabolites influence breast cancer progression and lactation health through the gut-breast axis.

supplements.title: Effect of Fermented Papaya Preparation Intake on Fatigue Recovery, Useful Field of View and Oxidative Stress: A Pilot Interventional Study in Professional Bus and Motor Racing Drivers.
supplements.summary: Fermented papaya supplement reduced fatigue and improved focus in professional drivers through antioxidant effects.

supplements.title: Nobiletin attenuates self-renewal in cervical cancer cells and spheres through miR-342-3p upregulation and FOXM1 downregulation.
supplements.summary: Nobiletin, a citrus compound, reduces cervical cancer cell self-renewal by increasing miR-342-3p and decreasing FOXM1 levels.

supplements.title: Baicalein Sensitizes Radioresistant BT549 and MCF7-R Breast Cancer Cells by Modulating Rac1 Signaling.
supplements.summary: Baicalein, a plant compound, makes radioresistant breast cancer cells more sensitive to radiation by blocking Rac1 protein activity.

supplements.title: Teprenone conjugated with a planar catechin analog enhances cytotoxicity against cancer cells.
supplements.summary: A new compound combining planar catechin and teprenone shows enhanced cancer cell-killing ability compared to catechin alone.

supplements.title: In vitro, in vivo, and anticytotoxic effects of silver nanoparticles green synthesized by Astragalus baba-alliar against Giardia lamblia infection.
supplements.summary: Silver nanoparticles synthesized from plant extract effectively killed Giardia parasites in lab and animal tests, offering a safer alternative to standard medications.

supplements.title: Optimizing Intervention Tools to Improve Nutrition and Physical Activity for Cancer Survivors (Tools To Be Fit)
supplements.summary: Study tests four intervention tools to help cancer survivors improve nutrition, physical activity, and weight after treatment completion.

supplements.title: Southern European Prospective Investigation Into Childhood Cancer and Nutrition (EPICkids)
supplements.summary: EPICkids tracks nutrition, lifestyle, and quality of life in Southern European children with acute lymphoblastic leukemia and brain tumors to improve treatment outcomes.

supplements.title: Protective Role of Apigenin-PEGylated Chitosan Nanoparticles Against Pesticide Deltamethrin-Induced Liver Injury via Antioxidant Activation, NF-κB Inhibition, and Bcl-2/Bax/Caspase-3 Signaling Modulation.
supplements.summary: Apigenin-loaded nanoparticles effectively protect rat livers from pesticide damage by boosting antioxidants and reducing inflammation.

supplements.title: Exploring the potential targets and mechanisms of artemisinin in the treatment of diabetic kidney disease using network pharmacology and molecular docking.
supplements.summary: Artemisinin may treat diabetic kidney disease by restoring the FLT1 protein, which protects kidney cells from high-glucose damage.

supplements.title: A bioactive pigment from violet-hued bacteria: a dual approach against prostate cancer and bacterial infections.
supplements.summary: A purple pigment from soil bacteria kills prostate cancer cells and fights bacterial infections effectively.

off_label.title: Targeting USP10/SCD1 axis by RAF265 suppresses lipogenesis and induced ferroptosis in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: RAF265 suppresses head and neck cancer growth by blocking USP10, reducing fat production and triggering cancer cell death.

off_label.title: Investigating the Efficacy of Propranolol in Treating Chronic Stress Combined with Colorectal Cancer in Mice and Its Antitumor Potential.
off_label.summary: Propranolol, a blood pressure medication, reduced colorectal cancer tumor growth in stressed mice, offering a potential treatment for cancer patients with depression.

off_label.title: Sulodexide attenuates sepsis-induced lung injury in neonatal rats via TNF-α pathway.
off_label.summary: Sulodexide, a protective compound, reduces lung damage in newborn rats with sepsis by blocking inflammatory pathways.

off_label.title: Mevalonate pathway rewiring driven by enhancer remodelling confers resistance to KRAS inhibitors in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: Colorectal cancer cells resist KRAS inhibitors by rewiring cholesterol production; combining statins with KRAS inhibitors restores treatment effectiveness.

off_label.title: An integrative mendelian randomisation and drug mechanism framework for target prioritisation and therapeutic repurposing in major depression.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified 54 drug repurposing candidates for depression by analyzing genetic data from 525,000 patients, prioritizing existing medications targeting novel depression mechanisms.

off_label.title: Pharmacologic Modulation of ARID3A with Rimegepant Reactivates Type I Interferon Signaling and Sensitizes Triple-Negative Breast Cancer to PD-1 Blockade.
off_label.summary: Drug rimegepant reactivates immune signaling in triple-negative breast cancer, making it responsive to immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Reductive death is averted by a conserved de novo lipogenic switch.
off_label.summary: Metformin's life-extending benefits require intact fat-making pathways to prevent toxic chemical buildup; this vulnerability could target certain cancers.

off_label.title: Unveiling the role of single versus repeated low-dose ketamine in attenuating doxorubicin-induced chemobrain and depression in rats: differential modulation of neuroinflammation, phosphorylated GLT-1, SERT, DAT and BDNF/TrkB signaling.
off_label.summary: Repeated low-dose ketamine better reduces chemobrain and depression caused by doxorubicin chemotherapy in rats through anti-inflammatory effects.

off_label.title: Microencapsulated oxfendazole modulates neuroinflammation in experimental Taenia crassiceps neurocysticercosis.
off_label.summary: Microencapsulated oxfendazole effectively treats brain parasitic infection while reducing harmful brain inflammation better than standard treatments.

off_label.title: Efficacy and Safety of Sacubitril/Valsartan in Protecting Cardiac Function in Patients Undergoing Chemotherapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
off_label.summary: Sacubitril/valsartan helps preserve heart function in cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy, though it may cause low blood pressure.

off_label.title: Statin Use and Survival in Early Breast Cancer According to Different Intrinsic Subtypes.
off_label.summary: Statins may improve survival in breast cancer patients, with benefits potentially varying across different cancer subtypes.

off_label.title: Aspirin or non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug initiation and subsequent bladder cancer evaluation.
off_label.summary: Starting aspirin or NSAIDs may reveal existing bladder cancers through bleeding, but the actual cancer-causing effect remains unclear.

off_label.title: Valproic acid: Mechanistic insights into neuronal actions, epigenetic modulation, and clinical risk.
off_label.summary: Valproic acid, used for decades in neuropsychiatric treatment, shows promise as an epigenetic cancer modifier but carries serious risks including birth defects and liver damage.

off_label.title: Combinatorial drug repurposing of Valproic acid and Zebularine regulates Krüppel-like factor 4 and β-catenin expression in colon cancer cells.
off_label.summary: Combining two repurposed drugs effectively inhibits colon cancer cell growth by altering key cancer-related gene expression.

off_label.title: Novel Long-Acting Ghrelin Analogue PEP-064 Restores Energy Balance in C26 and Lewis Lung Carcinoma-Induced cachexia in Mice.
off_label.summary: A new long-acting ghrelin drug called PEP-064 successfully restores weight and energy balance in mice with cancer cachexia.

biomarkers.title: Phase II Study of IV Busulfan Combined With 12 cGy of Fractionated Total Body Irradiation (FTBI) and Etoposide (VP-16) as a Preparative Regimen for Allogeneic Bone Marrow Transplantation for Patients With Advanced Hematological Malignancies
biomarkers.summary: A combination of chemotherapy and radiation before donor bone marrow transplant improves treatment outcomes for advanced blood cancers.

biomarkers.title: Characterization of T-cell Repertoire in Patients With AML Undergoing HSCT Through Next-Generation Sequencing of T Cell Receptor Alpha (TCRA) and T Cell Receptor Beta (TCRB) Genes
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are studying immune cell patterns in acute myeloid leukemia patients receiving stem cell transplants to understand immune system's role in treatment outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging Biomarkers for Radiation-Induced Neurocognitive Decline Following Stereotactic Radiosurgery of Newly Diagnosed Brain Metastases: An Observational Pilot Study
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified MRI biomarkers to predict thinking and memory problems in brain cancer patients treated with radiation therapy.

biomarkers.title: Safety and Efficacy Study of SPI-1005 for Prevention of Chemotherapy Induced Hearing Loss
biomarkers.summary: SPI-1005 was tested to prevent hearing loss in head and neck and lung cancer patients receiving platinum chemotherapy.

biomarkers.title: Vaginal Fluid Derived Biomarkers in the Early Detection and Evolution of Gynaecological Cancers
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are studying vaginal fluid biomarkers to improve early detection and monitoring of gynecological cancers using non-invasive tests.

biomarkers.title: Longitudinal Assessment and Natural History Study of Children and Adults With MEN2A or MEN2B With or Without Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are tracking how medullary thyroid cancer develops and progresses over time in children and adults with MEN2 genetic mutations.

biomarkers.title: Late Effects of Cancer Therapies on Gonadal Function, Fertility, Efficiency of Fertility Preservation Procedures and Pregnancy Outcomes (ProspectiveFemaleAYA)
biomarkers.summary: Study tracks fertility outcomes and gonadal damage in young female cancer survivors to improve personalized counseling and fertility preservation strategies.

biomarkers.title: Phase III Randomized and Double-blinded Trial of De-escalated Radiation in FMISO PET-selected Good Risk Versus Standard of Care Radiation in Unselected HPV Positive Oropharyngeal Cancer
biomarkers.summary: Study tests whether lower radiation doses reduce side effects while maintaining effectiveness in HPV-positive throat cancer patients.

biomarkers.title: Single Center Pilot Study to Investigate the Efficacy of Adding Itacitinib to Post-Transplant Cyclophosphamide as Graft-Versus-Host Disease Prophylaxis After Reduced Intensity Conditioning Matched Donor Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation With Peripheral Blood Stem Cells as Graft Source
biomarkers.summary: Researchers test adding itacitinib to standard drugs to better prevent graft-versus-host disease in stem cell transplant patients.

biomarkers.title: Evaluation of Gixam's Efficacy Predicting the Presence of Advanced and Non-advanced Colorectal Neoplasia in a FIT Negative Population
biomarkers.summary: Gixam device test evaluates its ability to detect colorectal precancer and cancer in patients with negative FIT results.

biomarkers.title: Observational Study of Cardiac Arrhythmias During Treatment With BTK Inhibitors or Venetoclax
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are monitoring how BTK inhibitor leukemia drugs affect heart rhythm to identify dangerous irregular heartbeats.

biomarkers.title: A Single-Arm, Open-Label Phase Ia/Ib Clinical Trial Evaluating the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetic Profile, and Preliminary Efficacy of FS-207 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors With High Microsatellite Instability (MSI-H)
biomarkers.summary: FS-207, a new oral drug, is being tested in advanced cancer patients with MSI-H tumors to evaluate safety and early anti-tumor activity.

biomarkers.title: Genome-Wide Association Study of Radiation Exposure and Bilateral Breast Cancer
biomarkers.summary: Researchers are identifying genetic factors that increase risk of second breast cancer in women who previously had radiation therapy.

biomarkers.title: Early-stage drug discovery in a new-generation ultrahigh-throughput mass spectrometry platform.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists developed an automated mass spectrometry platform that accelerates drug discovery by synthesizing and testing drug candidates in a single, streamlined process.

biomarkers.title: Lung cancer therapy using a chitosan-based nano drug discovery system of silver nanoparticles and chemotherapeutics.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed chitosan nanoparticles combined with silver and chemotherapy drugs to more effectively treat lung cancer.

trials.summary: A combination of chemotherapy and radiation before donor bone marrow transplant improves treatment outcomes for advanced blood cancers.

trials.title: The Effect of Web-Based Cancer Awareness Education in Schools on Students' Knowledge Level, Help-Seeking Behaviors, and Stigma Attitudes
trials.summary: Web-based cancer education in schools improved students' cancer knowledge, help-seeking behaviors, and reduced stigma attitudes.

trials.title: A Randomized Phase 3 Study of Brentuximab Vedotin (SGN-35) for Newly Diagnosed High-Risk Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma (cHL) in Children and Young Adults
trials.summary: A new drug called brentuximab vedotin combined with chemotherapy is tested against chemotherapy alone for high-risk Hodgkin lymphoma in children and young adults.

trials.title: A Phase II Study of the Rate of Conversion to Complete Resection in Patients With Initially Inoperable Hepatic-Only Metastases From Colorectal Cancer After Treatment With Hepatic Arterial Infusion With Floxuridine and Dexamethasone in Combination With Best Systemic Chemotherapy
trials.summary: A liver-directed chemotherapy approach combined with systemic chemotherapy makes initially inoperable colorectal cancer liver metastases surgically removable.

trials.title: A Phase 1/2 Clinical Trial of Quaratusugene Ozeplasmid and Atezolizumab Maintenance Therapy in Patients With Extensive Stage Small Cell Lung Cancer (ES-SCLC)
trials.summary: Researchers are testing a new combination therapy using quaratusugene ozeplasmid and atezolizumab as maintenance treatment for extensive stage small cell lung cancer.

trials.title: Feasibility of Early Swallowing and Speech Intervention for Head and Neck Cancer Patients Treated SURGically
trials.summary: Researchers are testing whether early speech therapy before surgery helps head and neck cancer patients avoid swallowing problems and feeding tubes.
